results.title: Switch
results.overview: A young woman tries to leave her old life behind. Dark forces pursue her, and she experiences a moral awakening.

results.title: Gambit
results.overview: Leonard, a conflicted introvert, has been convinced by his brother Tyler to jointly rob a jewellery store. Leonard, unbeknownst to Tyler, has been persuaded by his lover, Olivia, to take the money and run. In this crime drama, Leonard will have to decide what his final move will be.

results.title: Amoris
results.overview: Amarus is a travelling salesman of sorts in a world where some choose to carry the whispers of their souls in handcrafted wooden boxes. Loosely inspired by Plato's 3 phases of love (Scala Amoris), we follow Amarus through various flashes of romance, in a metaphorical tale about vulnerability, closure, and self-revelation. Blurring the lines of music video and cinema, AMORIS spotlights the core of what's most important to both...storytelling.

results.title: First Kiss
results.overview: What happens when a memory from your youth becomes a journey across an ocean? Forty years after sharing her first kiss with a young man in France, Lena returns to the place where it happened - this time determined to find him.

results.title: Now What?
results.overview: An intimate portrait of a relationship suspended in time - a breath held before the plunge. Alice and Paul have exhausted words; the silence between them resonates with everything unspoken. They stand at the edge of something irreversible, knowing change must come, yet unsure if they're brave enough to face it.

results.title: Sambhavna: A Story of Possibility, Healing, and Hope
results.original_title: Sambhavna: A Story of Possibility, Healing, and Hope
results.overview: Forty years after the Bhopal tragedy, one of the worst industrial disasters in history, thousands of people are still living with the devastating effects of chemical contamination.

results.title: Unmade Film: The Reconnaissance
results.overview: Set in the landscape that contains the remains of the emptied village of Lifta, once situated outside Jerusalem. It is one of the few surviving traces of over four hundred Palestinian towns and villages depopulated in 1948.

results.title: British Museum Stop
results.overview: A short stop-motion film about two friends’ hatred of the British Museum in Amsterdam.

results.title: Tuvimos el deseo de romperlo todo
results.original_title: Tuvimos el deseo de romperlo todo
results.overview: During an impossible summer in Havana, Ava, a young trans artist, proposes that we film a fiction so she can kiss the boy she likes. We become accomplices to that impulse, using cinema as a refuge to rewrite our own story and escape from a reality in crisis.

results.title: SPANK DAT FOID
results.overview: Shot on a whim one night in October, a self-proclaimed “foid” is saved from death by a divine spirit, granting her a second chance at life and sending her on a quest of self-discovery, love, and danger.

results.title: DO YOU KNOW GIRL?
results.overview: Over the course of one day, teenage girl ANDIE, who transforms herself for every girl she meets—carefully curating mood boards, mannerisms, and borrowed personas in her desperate search for love and a self of her own. But when her carefully constructed identities begin to unravel alongside her dangerous relationship with her sugar daddy, ANDIE is forced to confront the one question she has spent all day avoiding: Who are you, really, girl?

results.title: Beyond the Mist
results.overview: Yu Yang, a driver with a long-held music dream, is going through a rough patch due to the threat of a layoff. To keep his job, he has no choice but to get involved in the dispute between his boss and his boss's domestically abused wife, accidentally triggering a series of cascading incidents.

results.title: Angel's Torah
results.overview: This is the 100-year story of Angel Wagenstein. A direct witness to at least three historical revolutions, a participant in the underground resistance during the Second World War, a prisoner in a concentration camp, a fighter against fascism, a man sentenced to death, the creator of fifty-two screenplays, a film and theater director, the author of four novels and countless pages of non-fiction, and the recipient of hundreds of awards from all corners of the globe. A Bulgarian citizen and a German pensioner—a rebel with a sparkling sense of humor and an independent spirit—who managed to remain true to himself throughout every era he lived through.
